messages:
samir: Quick postmortem follow-up — the cross-region traffic spike last night looks tied to repeated TLS handshakes from a small subset of egress hosts. Observed ~6x retry amplification for cert negotiation across us-east->eu-west during the 22:05-22:20 window.
alejandra: Agree with the initial signal. I pulled pcap + loadbalancer logs and saw a mix of retransmits + 502s from the edge before TLS completes. attaching short grep output in thread.
maggie: Can we list concrete hypotheses and owners? we should avoid another weekend surprise.
raj: Hypothesis 1: cert rotation + stale session cache mismatch causing full handshake fallback. Owner: raj. Timeline: investigation today, mitigation by EOD if trivial (cache flush).
raj: Hypothesis 2: route flap + reordering causing packet loss that surfaces as handshake retries. Owner: samir. Timeline: infra probe + probe config changes tomorrow.
kai: Hypothesis 3: client-side retry policy + aggressive backoff misconfig on certain customers. Owner: alejandra. Timeline: audit of retry config and customer history in 48h.
samir: Action items I propose: 1) raj to run targeted cache flush test on a small subset and monitor handshake success. 2) samir to adjust probe TTL and enable additional packet captures. 3) alejandra to audit retry headers and any customer-side SDK changes. 4) maggie to coordinate rollout plan and QA.
alejandra: I'll start the audit now, will share a filtered list of customers that match the UA and SDK version within 2 hours.
maggie: I'll draft a canary playbook for cache flush with rollback steps. include metrics to watch: TLS handshake latency, 502 count, retransmit rate, per-region tail latency.
raj: Running cache flush dry-run on stage: command I'm using: ``redis-cli -h cache-edge-1 FLUSHDB`` (we'll use a targeted key prefix in prod). noting we'll throttle to avoid global cold start.
samir: For capture: deploying tcpdump filter on lb-proxy nodes: ``tcpdump -w /tmp/handshake-us-east.pcap 'tcp port 443 and host 10.1.2.34'``. I'll share pcaps to the secure bucket.
devops-bot: Reminder: maintenance window required for prod cache flush if >5% of nodes impacted. Please open a maintenance ticket.
alejandra: opened ticket MN-9034 and pinned to this thread. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MN-9034
kai: Quick Q — any SLA hits? we saw a small uptick in 95th tail, but no customer-visible error spike reported. confirm?
maggie: confirmed — no page escalations, SLO still within 99.9 for the hour, but routing noise could amplify.
raj: Prod targeted cache flush scheduled in 3h for a single AZ, fallback plan: revert cache routing and re-enable session pinning. owner/rollback: raj, 30m to verify.
samir: I'll have the probes running pre/post and will post a short rollout dashboard snapshot.
alejandra: audit initial results: 12 customers match UA/SKD pattern, 3 of them show repeated TLS client hello retransmits. uploading list to secure docs.
maggie: QA plan: smoke with synthetic traffic from eu-west to us-east after flush, validate 1000 handshake successes with <50ms handshake time. I will own verification and post results.
raj: Post-flush check-in: handshake retransmit rate dropped ~78% on flushed node within 10m. pushing to 2 more nodes as a cautious ramp.
samir: good sign. set a 2-hour observation window before broader rollout. please add metric alert for retransmit rate > 15% in any AZ.
alejandra: customer outreach: I'll draft a short note for affected customers once we hit stable post-rollout.
maggie: owners and deadlines recap: raj (cache flush + rollout) — today + 2h observation; samir (packet captures + probe config) — capture now, probe tweaks tomorrow; alejandra (retry audit + outreach) — audit 48h, outreach after stability; kai (SLA watch) — monitor and sign off.
raj: Finished flush for 2 nodes. keeping one node as control. pushing metrics to dashboard.
samir: devops-bot triggered maintenance start: MN-9034 at 2765414000 (simulated) :wrench:
devops-bot: Deploy note: if rollback needed, tag: rollback/cache-routing-2026-03-23.
alejandra: initial outreach draft posted to docs, PTAL @maggie @samir.
maggie: LGTM, send if we remain stable after the 2h window.
raj: 45m into observation: retransmit rate stable and 502s reduced on flushed nodes. proceeding to next AZ in 30m.
alejandra: audit note: no evidence of SDK change correlated to spikes. seems infra-side.
kai: thanks team — please keep this thread for final postmortem action item closure. we'll link to the PM follow-up doc.
samir: will drop final summary + timestamps + dashboard links once rollout completes. thanks all. :thumbsup:
